description: This Java class 'MappedInboundExternalMessage' represents a wrapper for inbound signals that are mapped from external messages within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity services. It encapsulates an ExternalMessage, a TopicPath, and a Signal, providing methods to access these components, as well as 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString' implementations.

classes.name: MappedInboundExternalMessage
classes.description: Immutable class representing a mapped inbound external message with associated topic path and signal.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance with provided ExternalMessage, TopicPath, and Signal.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the TopicPath associated with the message.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Returns the Signal associated with the message.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare based on externalMessage, topicPath, and signal.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on externalMessage, topicPath, and signal.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.
